problem_solved: Addresses the consumer demand for clean-label, caffeine-free functional beverages with natural botanical and wellness properties.
description: Aqua Flora-Infuse is a caffeine-free herbal drink formulation crafted from a curated mix of medicinal plants, primarily Nelumbo nucifera (lotus) and Clitoria ternatea. Developed using a gentle drying technique, the process preserves essential photoactives and floral aromas without synthetic additives. Lotus aids in relaxation and detoxification, while Clitoria ternatea provides natural color, rich anthocyanin content, and supports cognitive function. Packaged in ready-to-use tea bags, the formulation targets the clean-label, functional beverage market by combining traditional botanical ingredients with eco-friendly processing.
applications:

• Adoption by nutraceutical brands for wellness product lines

• Integration into Ayurveda-based product portfolios

• Retail distribution through premium wellness stores and export markets
